sections.title: CNTRL AND ERN GULF COAST STATES/CAROLINAS/CNTRL APPALACHIANS
sections.text: A WELL-DEVELOPED SQUALL-LINE WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF AL AND SRN MS INTO GA THIS EVENING. MODERATE INSTABILITY IS IN PLACE WELL TO THE EAST OF THE LINE WITH MLCAPE VALUES ESTIMATED IN THE 1000 TO 2000 J/KG RANGE ACROSS MOST OF SE AL AND WCNTRL GA. THIS ALONG WITH STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES ASSOCIATED WITH A 80 TO 100 KT MID-LEVEL JET WILL PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR A WIDESPREAD SEVERE THREAT THROUGH LATE EVENING. WSR-88D VWPS ACROSS SE AL AND CNTRL GA SHOW 35 TO 40 KT OF FLOW JUST ABOVE THE SFC. THE STRONG LOW-LEVEL FLOW COMBINED WITH A FORWARD SPEED OF THE LINE OF 30 TO 40 KT SHOULD BE VERY FAVORABLE FOR WIND DAMAGE THIS EVENING. THE GREATEST WIND DAMAGE THREAT SHOULD EXIST WITH BOWING LINE-SEGMENTS AND LEWP STRUCTURES. A FEW TORNADOES MAY ALSO OCCUR WITH ROTATING CELLS EMBEDDED IN THE LINE OR WITH ISOLATED SUPERCELLS THAT DEVELOP AHEAD OF THE LINE ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR. THE GREATEST TORNADO THREAT SHOULD BE ACROSS SRN MS...FAR SE LA AND SRN AL EARLY THIS EVENING DUE TO THE STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR PROFILES AND THE MORE DISCRETE NATURE OF THE STORMS ON THE SRN END OF THE LINE.
